.pairwiseTests

Source: R/plotResults.R
dot-pairwiseTests.Rd

Runs a two-sample test between each pair of groups on the values of one region, as they are drawn, pairing the samples through a column of the metadata when asked to.

Usage

.pairwiseTests(
  plotTable,
  colTable,
  test = "t.test",
  pairBy = NULL,
  comparisons = NULL,
  groupLevels,
  pAdjustMethod = "none"
)

Arguments

plotTable

Data.frame with one row per sample and the sample, value and group columns.

colTable

Data.frame with the sample metadata and a sample column.

test

String with the test, either "t.test" or "wilcox.test". Default: "t.test".

pairBy

String with the column pairing the samples, or NULL for unpaired tests. Default: NULL.

comparisons

List of character vectors of length two, or NULL for every pair of groups. Default: NULL.

groupLevels

Character vector with the groups, in the order of the axis.

pAdjustMethod

String with the correction applied across the comparisons. Default: "none".

Value

A data.frame with one row per comparison and the group1, group2, n.first, n.second, p.value and p.adjusted columns. With pairBy the two sizes are the number of pairs.
